target_standard: Engineers Australia (EA) Stage 1 Competency Standard for Professional Engineer

PE1.1_theory_knowledge.title: Comprehensive, theory-based understanding of the underpinning natural and physical sciences and engineering fundamentals
PE1.1_theory_knowledge.evidence_summary: 104-114年台灣電機技師國家考試高階專業認證 (電路學、電力系統、電機機械、工數)

PE1.2_discipline_knowledge.title: Conceptual understanding of the, mathematics, numerical analysis, statistics, and computer and information sciences which underpin the engineering discipline
PE1.2_discipline_knowledge.evidence_summary: 高階電力潮流矩陣計算、故障分析演算法、自動化分析 Python/SymPy 工具鏈

PE1.3_specialist_knowledge.title: In-depth understanding of specialist body of knowledge within the engineering discipline
PE1.3_specialist_knowledge.evidence_summary: 重電設備選型、變電所系統、特高壓供電與配電保護協調

PE2.1_problem_solving.title: Application of established engineering methods to complex engineering problem solving
PE2.1_problem_solving.evidence_summary: 高階工業工程與重電設計專案經驗，解決複雜電氣負載與電壓降問題

PE2.2_fluent_application.title: Fluent application of engineering techniques, tools and resources
PE2.2_fluent_application.evidence_summary: ETAP / PSCAD / PSS/E / Python 數據管線及工程圖面分析

PE2.3_design_processes.title: Application of systematic engineering synthesis and design processes
PE2.3_design_processes.evidence_summary: 遵循 AS/NZS 標準與國際 IEC/IEEE 規範之變電所與配電設計

PE3.1_ethical_conduct.title: Ethical conduct and professional accountability
PE3.1_ethical_conduct.evidence_summary: 恪守專業技師倫理與重電安全規範

PE3.2_communication.title: Effective oral and written communication in professional and lay domains
PE3.2_communication.evidence_summary: 撰寫 CDR (Competency Demonstration Report) 與技術規格書

PE3.6_leadership_teamwork.title: Effective team membership and team leadership
PE3.6_leadership_teamwork.evidence_summary: 跨領域工程協調與專案時程管理
